ops.text: 2.11 Affiliates. All licenses granted to Corio under this Section 2 extend to any affiliate of Corio identified by written notice to Commerce One, provided that Corio remains responsible for such affiliate's compliance with the terms of this Agreement.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Section 2 grants run to Corio alone with no path to add our affiliates, so we have inserted a short subsection extending those licenses to affiliates we identify by written notice to Commerce One, with us responsible for their compliance. Successor transfer in an M&A transaction is already permitted by Section 14.1, so no further change is needed.
proposal.summary: Extend the Section 2 licences to Corio affiliates identified by written notice to Commerce One.

mappings.element: Licence transferable to a successor in an M&A transaction.
mappings.quote: either party shall have the right to assign this Agreement in connection with the merger or acquisition of such party or the sale of all or substantially all of its assets related to this Agreement without such consent
